Hi Ayesha —

Appreciate the clear asks. Short answer: we can offer a documented temporary SLA carve-out for the preview, but it comes with a few guardrails. High-level proposal below; happy to iterate with your ops team and legal.

Proposed temporary commitments (preview window):
- Availability: 99.5% (measured at the tenant+model route level) — temporary for the first 30 days of public preview.
- P99 latency target: 320ms for typical prompt lengths; best-effort for longer sequences.
- Maintenance: scheduled maintenance windows will be announced 72 hours in advance and limited to 2 hours per week maximum during preview.
- Fall-through: automatic fallback to our stable Llama-2-compatible route when the preview model is unavailable; fallbacks preserve tokens but may add ~40–120ms.

Compensations & mitigations:
- If availability drops below 99.5% for any billing day, we will apply a pro-rated credit for affected tokens (details in attached SLA draft).
- We will provide a dedicated engineer (Dev Patel) as a contact for escalation during the preview ramp.

Next steps: Sean — can you and Dev sanity-check the draft SLA and confirm we can operationally support the rollback/fallback behavior? Ayesha/Evan — once we have internal sign-off we'll send a one-page carve-out your legal/ops can accept.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
